name: nexus-cloud
description: NEXUS CLOUD - Setup Your Own Cloud for SaaS over an Existing LAN Using a Custom Cloud Controller and HDFS

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: npx concurrently "npm run hdfs" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
